Every copied bootstrap/snapshot binding, source, binary, model and prepared input is checked; current platform/Python/compiler must equal frozen host.

All 28 intents/results must match their original plan unit, exact command argv, zero return codes and expected sequence. Every closed artifact is rehashed; complete directory inventory rejects open intents, partial outputs and additional files.
Continuation invokes the unchanged execute_plan with the original run directory and sequence 1. Existing completed results route directly through sync_result; their model callbacks are skipped.

Original row-027 result is reverified/uploaded at sequence 56 before row-028 can receive intent sequence 57. DurableArchive compares already present remote manifests and file contents, and accepts a new unit only at the next contiguous sequence.
